pictures.name: SK1-Two-Swords
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. Amritsar, early 1600s, inside a simple sacred hall with pools of lamplight. A young Guru of about eleven in a royal saffron robe and a tall turban with a plume is seen only from behind, his face never visible, as a revered old Sikh with a long white beard and white turban holds out two curved swords in jeweled scabbards across his open palms. Rich silks, deep blue shadows, warm gold light.

A still-life on a rich saffron and blue cloth on a stone ledge in the mountains at golden hour: two curved swords in jeweled scabbards lie crossed beside a string of prayer beads and a small closed cloth-wrapped book, no visible letters. pictures.name: SK5-Flag
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. A tall Sikh flagpole wrapped in saffron cloth rises beside a white-domed gurdwara at dusk, its triangular saffron flag lifting in the wind, showing the Khanda emblem in deep blue: a circle, a straight double-edged sword through the middle, and two curved swords curving around the outside. pictures.name: SK6-Today-Desk

A young Sikh woman in a smart blazer, her long hair in a braid, a small Khanda pendant on a chain at her neck and a steel kara on her wrist, pauses at her laptop between stacks of papers and closes her eyes for one calm breath, a faint smile.
